articles.title: At competing Stampede breakfasts, 2 very different visions for Alberta emerge
articles.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney attended the Calgary Stampede, met with First Nation leaders, and engaged with Albertans amid political tensions over Alberta's October 19 referendum on separation.

articles.title: More than 2,000 Canadians have donated toward restoration of 24 Sussex Drive
articles.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney announced a fundraising campaign and national design competition to restore the prime minister's official residence, with more than 2,000 individual donors already contributing.

articles.title: Carney courts Saudi Arabia as U.S.-Iran ceasefire collapses
articles.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney sought to deepen diplomatic and economic ties with Saudi Arabia, his first visit to the country in over two decades, while navigating renewed U.S.-Iran military conflict.

articles.title: Carney backs latest U.S. strikes on Iran as Trump slams NATO allies
articles.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney endorsed U.S. military strikes on Iran as justified responses to ceasefire violations while speaking at the NATO summit in Turkey.

articles.title: Carney appoints one of his top advisers and a Conservative MP to Senate
articles.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney appointed longtime Liberal strategist Tim Pitfield and Conservative MP Richard Martel to the Senate, signaling a shift toward more partisan appointments compared to his predecessor's approach.
